title: TOOL_CALL_REJECTED payload
description: A call refused at a full queue, refused on the direct path because its permission is outside the current scope, or dropped at drain.

permission.description: The permission the call asked for; present on a direct call refused for its scope, which has no TOOL_CALL_QUEUED event to carry it.

direct.description: Present when the call was submitted with a client attached and no escalation pending and was refused without being queued (reason scope).
